title: Lantern
line: A daily MBTA subway reliability board with tested refreshes. From August 11 to November 8, 2026, 11.8% of train runs ran late.
source: Real MBTA data. dbt, DuckDB, SQL, GitHub Actions, MapLibre.
alt: Screenshot of the live Lantern board

title: Demand Pulse
line: Walmart sales forecasting and inventory planning. On the April 25 to May 22, 2016 holdout, the plan missed sales by 19.87%.
source: Real M5 Walmart sales. Simulated inventory.
alt: Screenshot of the live Demand Pulse board

title: CDC
line: Respiratory illness monitoring on public CDC data, with answers you can trace back to the source. It refreshes nightly.
source: Public CDC data. Python, FastAPI, DuckDB, React, GitHub Actions.
alt: Screenshot of the live CDC respiratory virus dashboard

title: Mirage
line: A shelf-availability and replenishment board. On the September 22, 2026 snapshot, 22.5% of shelves at the Everett store were empty.
source: Synthetic store and distribution-center data. SQL, T-SQL, Python, Tableau.
alt: Screenshot of the live Mirage board
